current.text: He plays for Portland after a trade from Memphis.
Portland's backcourt is crowded. Damian Lillard, Jrue Holiday, Scoot Henderson and Deni Avdija all share the ball and the playmaking with him.
He is likely to come off the bench for about 27 to 28 minutes. Jrue Holiday or Scoot Henderson should start most nights next to Lillard.
Portland has a new, first-time head coach who may mix up the lineup. Minutes and usage are expected to swing from game to game.
His usage should fall by almost 5 points from the 33% he had in Memphis. His assists may not hold at 8 per game.
Experts see him as a weird fit in Portland who mutes the strengths of Lillard and Avdija.
Experts doubt that last season's 90% free throw mark will hold.
Do not take him in the top 90 in category leagues. In an auction he is worth about 5 USD, and maybe 10 USD if everything goes right. One expert passed on him around pick 98.
He should still play enough minutes to beat a Yahoo rank of 103.
He is a tier 8 point guard on his median outcome. Averaging 24 points and 9 assists, or playing 65 games, is possible but unlikely.
With a March 28 end, Portland plays 10 games in our playoff weeks, a weak schedule, with three back-to-backs in those weeks. The team has 15 back-to-backs this season.

durable.text: He has durability concerns and has struggled to stay healthy.
He has had off-court problems and was suspended by his own team.
He is a high-usage playmaker who piles up assists, even in seasons with few games.
He is a poor shooter from the field and from three, and he does not move off the ball.
His free throw shooting has improved a lot.
He is described as a terrible defender.
Turnovers are his weakest category by far, both against the league and against guards.
He is not a good category player. He is worth more in points leagues, and his fantasy game is not robust.

note: Experts value him at about 5 USD, up to 10 USD if everything goes right. That matches Yahoo (5 USD value, rank 94) and is far below the 17 USD he cost in our league last season, so do not chase him near that price. His assists, points and FT% help, but 3.6 turnovers per game and a 44% FG% make him a fit mainly for punt TO builds. Early in the season, check whether he starts or comes off the bench, whether he gets 27 to 28 minutes, and whether his assists hold next to Lillard, Holiday and Henderson. Portland's 10-game playoff schedule is weak.
